summary: Interpreted the long-run receipt and closed the short-window limitation of the split-brain chain. Receipt 861a2b3c62bb44d7aed2eee9b95aa15f evaluated all six comparisons: after the healed cluster committed roughly two hundred further entries the feature-on run still held different payloads at the conflict index (violated, witness index 3), the restarted node still reported {A,B,C} (violated, index 3), the run was confirmed substantial and progressing (long_run_exercised and a_log_advanced_after_heal hold at index 3), while the feature-off control over the same schedule stayed consistent and reported {A,B,C,D,E} (holds, index 8). The experiment-level interpretation is violated/asserted with those indices and the mechanism traced to the same-term duplicate skip plus the unrepaired configuration scan; the child and parent accounts were rewritten so "all receipts use short sampling windows" becomes the observed long run, with the remaining limits restated (entry-count window with no membership change or snapshot install, harness-arranged lag for the repair, unexercised user Restore and term-changing truncation, in-memory stores with scaled timeouts and a graceful restart), joint histories extended across the six- and seven-receipt chains, and the same-term divergence fact supplemented with this receipt. Incomplete: the user Restore and term-changing truncation repair paths, and the operational frequency of the fall-behind that triggers the snapshot repair.
